description_en:
EUROGRIND MGA+ is a mineral grinding aid designed for use with 
minerals such as cement raw materials, coal, pure calcium carbonate, 
limestone, silica, and quicklime.
description_ar:
EUROGRIND MGA is a mineral grinding aid designed for use with 
minerals such as cement raw materials, coal, pure calcium carbonate, 
limestone, silica, and quicklime.
uses_en: ["EUROGRIND MGA+ can be utilized for grinding most minerals in all","types of grinding systems, including those with ball mills, open and","closed circuits, roll presses, horizontal roller mills, and vertical roller","mills."]
uses_ar: ["EUROGRIND MGA can be utilized for grinding most minerals in all","types of grinding systems, including those with ball mills, open and","closed circuits, roll presses, horizontal roller mills, and vertical roller","mills."]
advantages_en: ["Improved Grinding Efficiency: EUROGRIND MGA reduces energy consumption by optimizing the grinding process, making it more cost-effective","Reduction in CO2 Emissions: By improving the efficiency of the mineral production process, our products help reduce energy use and minimize the carbon footprint","Cost Savings: With improved grinding and performance, our products lead to reduced material costs and increased","productivity in the manufacturing process"]

packaging_en:
EUROGRIND MGA+ is supplied in 205 and 1000 liter 
bulk supply.

storage_en:
EUROGRIND MGA+ should be stored and maintained 
at temperatures between 1°C and 50°C.
The shelf life of EUROGRIND MGA+ is at least 12 
months from the date of production.
